$comment: Frictionless Table Schema (https://specs.frictionlessdata.io/table-schema/) for the Cambodia factory registry. Cross-field / business-logic rules that a schema can't express (province validity, geo bounding box, date consistency, OS ID shape, employee-count outliers, Khmer script) live in gatekeeper/checks.py instead -- see README.md for which layer owns what.

fields.name: Factory Name (KM)
fields.description: Should contain Khmer script -- checked by the khmer-name custom check, not enforced here.

fields.name: Open Supply ID
fields.description: Structural shape (2-letter country + 4-digit year + 3-digit day-of-year + 6 chars = 15 total) is checked as an advisory warning by the os-id-format custom check.

fields.name: ID in MOC
fields.description: No fixed pattern enforced yet -- MOC registration numbers didn't have a confidently-known format at authoring time. Add a `pattern` constraint here once you've confirmed one against real MOC data.

fields.name: Province
fields.description: Validated against Cambodia's 25 provinces (with alias suggestions for common variant spellings) by the province custom check, rather than a hard schema enum -- see gatekeeper/rules.py:PROVINCE_ALIASES.

fields.name: District
fields.description: Not yet cross-checked against Province (a real Province->District gazetteer is needed for that -- see README 'Extending this tool').

fields.name: Region
fields.description: Free text by default (e.g. Plains / Tonle Sap / Coastal / Plateau-Mountain informal groupings). Turn into an enum once you've confirmed the exact category labels your source uses.

fields.name: Registered Date
fields.description: Expected as ISO YYYY-MM-DD. If your source exports DD/MM/YYYY or similar, set e.g. "format": "%d/%m/%Y" here instead of normalizing the source file.

fields.name: Number of Employees
fields.description: Hard floor at 0. Implausibly large values are flagged as an advisory warning by the employee-count custom check rather than hard-capped here, since a hard maximum would silently reject genuinely large factories.

fields.name: Lat
fields.description: Coarse national bounding box. Both-present/both-blank pairing with Long, and the exact same bounding box, are re-checked together by the geo-pair custom check (kept in one place: gatekeeper/rules.py:CAMBODIA_BBOX).

fields.name: Sector
fields.description: Free text by default -- turn into an enum (e.g. Garment, Footwear, Travel Goods, Textile, Electronics) once you've confirmed the controlled vocabulary your source actually uses.
